notes: One servo on one board in one sitting: mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D, stage 3's camera sitting servo-camera-9 (21 chains, 5 V) through oscnb.potframes, and stage 3's windows and duty steps of the pair. Estimators causal, float, one row per control tick (oscnb.velocity, oscnb.speed); truths offline (the tag through the same kernel, the ripple tach, each window's own). Zero: stage 1's tracker in float, the state after the row before. Back-EMF: k_d = 0, both brush forms side by side, never trimmed against the pot or the tag. Lookup: the position result's. The blend is not chosen. Brackets: +/- se unless the unit says otherwise. Tables in .slopes.csv, .crossover.csv, .rest.csv and .blends.csv.
